derivation:
by
  have h := Scheme.preimage_eq_top_of_closedPoint_mem (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X)) (U := V) (by simpa using hη)
  simp only [kumHom, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
explanation: Apply the declaration to the canonical map from the generic-point stalk spectrum. Its closed point maps to the generic point, so V pulls back to ⊤. Pulling back further along the Spec.map defining kumHom preserves ⊤.
